description: Correct the tachycitin sequence using PDB 1DQC SEQRES and recompute net charge, pI and aromatic content for all mite and reference chitin-binding domains
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# ===========================================================================
# CORRECTION + PROVENANCE: the UniProt accession P82107 used in the previous
# block is NOT tachycitin.  Take the authentic tachycitin sequence from the
# SEQRES of its NMR structure 1DQC, and the Bacillus chitin-binding domain
# from 1ED7, then recompute net charge for all reference domains.
# ===========================================================================
A3=dict(zip(["ALA","CYS","ASP","GLU","PHE","GLY","HIS","ILE","LYS","LEU","MET","ASN","PRO","GLN","ARG","SER","THR","VAL","TRP","TYR"],"ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY"))
def seqres(pdbid,chain='A'):
    t=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pdbid}.pdb",timeout=90).text
    aa=[]
    for l in t.splitlines():
        if l.startswith("SEQRES") and l[11]==chain: aa+= l[19:].split()
    return "".join(A3.get(a,'X') for a in aa)
tachy=seqres("1DQC"); chbd=seqres("1ED7")
print("1DQC (tachycitin) :",tachy,"len",len(tachy),"nCys",tachy.count('C'))
print("1ED7 (ChBD-ChiA1) :",chbd,"len",len(chbd))
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P82107.txt",timeout=60).text
print("\nWhat P82107 actually is:",[l for l in r.split("\n") if l.startswith("DE ") or l.startswith("OS ")][:4])

def up_seq(a):
    return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
lep=up_seq("Q1M2L5"); dp15=up_seq("Q4JK70")
DOM={'Der p 23 core 43-90':up_seq("L7N6F8")[42:],'Der f 23 core':up_seq("A0A088SAW7")[43:],
 'Blo t 12 CBM14':up_seq("Q17282")[94:],'Lep d 12 CBM14':lep[93:],
 'Der p 18 CBM14':up_seq("Q4JK71")[406:],'Der p 15 CBM14':dp15[475:],
 'tachycitin 1DQC (chitin+)':tachy,'ChBD-ChiA1 1ED7 (chitin+)':chbd,
 'Der p 23 full mature 22-90':up_seq("L7N6F8")[21:]}
pKa={'D':3.65,'E':4.25,'C':8.18,'Y':10.07,'H':6.00,'K':10.53,'R':12.48}
def charge(s,pH):
    q=1/(1+10**(pH-8.2))-1/(1+10**(3.65-pH))
    for a in s:
        if a in 'KRH': q+=1/(1+10**(pH-pKa[a]))
        elif a in 'DECY': q-=1/(1+10**(pKa[a]-pH))
    return q
def pI(s):
    lo,hi=0.,14.
    for _ in range(60):
        m=(lo+hi)/2
        if charge(s,m)>0: lo=m
        else: hi=m
    return (lo+hi)/2
rows=[dict(domain=k,len=len(s),D_E=sum(c in 'DE' for c in s),K_R=sum(c in 'KR' for c in s),
           net_q_pH7=round(charge(s,7.0),2),pI=round(pI(s),2),
           arom_FWY=sum(c in 'FWY' for c in s),
           arom_pct=round(sum(c in 'FWY' for c in s)/len(s)*100,1)) for k,s in DOM.items()]
t=pd.DataFrame(rows); print("\n"+t.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5))
lab=list(t.domain); yq=t.net_q_pH7.values
c=['#2ca02c' if 'chitin+' in l else ('#d62728' if 'Der p 23' in l else '#1f77b4') for l in lab]
ax.barh(range(len(lab)),yq,color=c); ax.axvline(0,c='k',lw=0.8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(lab))); ax.set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=9); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel('net charge at pH 7.0 (Henderson-Hasselbalch, standard side-chain pKa)')
ax.set_title('Charge of Der p 23 versus mite CBM14 relatives and two reference chitin-binding modules\n'
             'green = demonstrated chitin binder, red = Der p 23')
for i,v in enumerate(yq):
    ax.text(v+(0.25 if v>0 else -0.25),i,f"{v:+.1f} (pI {t.pI[i]:.2f}, {t.arom_pct[i]:.1f}% F/W/Y)",
            va='center',ha='left' if v>0 else 'right',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(min(yq)-7,max(yq)+5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
